    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    BiasValidator
    Detects prompts containing prohibited bias terms using regex patterns grouped by protected category (gender, religion, caste, etc.).
    CategorizedPattern
    Immutable definition of a compiled guardrail pattern with scoring metadata.
    CustomGuardrailValidator
    Extension point for team-specific guardrail validators.
    EmbeddingNormalizationUtil
    L2-normalises embedding vectors so cosine distance (<=>) equals one minus cosine similarity for pgvector queries.
    EmbeddingProvider
    Contract for generating dense text embeddings locally.
    FuzzyMatchUtil
    Optional fuzzy matching for spacing tricks, symbol insertion, and stretched characters.
    GuardrailAutoConfiguration
    Spring Boot auto-configuration for guardrail validators and web support.
    GuardrailContext
    Context passed through the guardrail pipeline for logging and routing.
    GuardrailController
    Optional REST endpoint for evaluating prompts (Postman-friendly).
    GuardrailEngine
    Central guardrail engine that orchestrates the validation pipeline.
    GuardrailEngineAutoConfiguration
    Creates GuardrailEngine after semantic beans when semantic mode is active, so the pipeline includes SEMANTIC instead of logging a false "missing" warning.
    GuardrailErrorResponse
    Structured error response returned when a guardrail violation is caught.
    GuardrailEvaluateRequest
    Standard evaluate request body for Postman and HTTP clients.
    GuardrailExceptionHandler
    Global exception handler that catches GuardrailViolationException and returns a structured 422 JSON response instead of a 500 error.
    GuardrailMetrics
    Observability hooks for guardrail pipeline stages.
    GuardrailPatternRegistry
    Central registry of compiled regex patterns shared across validators.

    pgvector-backed store for unsafe semantic patterns.
    PiiSanitizingValidator
    Strips PII from prompts before they reach external LLM APIs.

    Detects common prompt injection and jailbreak attempts using shared patterns from GuardrailPatternRegistry.

    Normalises inbound text so validators always receive the user prompt, not a raw JSON envelope.
    PromptInputResolver.Resolved
     
    RedisEmbeddingCache
    Redis L2 cache for generated embeddings.
    SanitizingValidator
    A validator that also transforms/sanitises the prompt text.
    SemanticAutoConfiguration
    Semantic layer auto-configuration (ONNX + pgvector).
    SemanticCategory
    Semantic violation categories stored in pgvector alongside each unsafe pattern.
    SemanticMatch
    A single pgvector similarity hit returned by PgVectorSemanticStore.
    SemanticPatternSeeder
    Populates the pgvector pattern store with embeddings generated from guardrail_seed_text.
    SemanticStartupInitializer
    Validates the semantic validation layer at startup and seeds pgvector embeddings when guardrail_semantic_patterns is empty.
    SemanticValidator
    Semantic validation at pipeline order 400 (after regex validators and PII sanitisation).
    TextNormalizationUtil
    Normalizes obfuscated or adversarial text before guardrail validation.
    ToxicityValidator
    Detects toxic, abusive, violent, or unsafe language with severity scoring.
    ValidationAction
    Recommended enforcement action derived from a validator's scoring logic.
    Violation
    A single guardrail violation detected during pipeline processing.
    ViolationSeverity
    Severity levels for guardrail violations.
